info.title: POWER-SUB: Energy Waste Detection & Intelligent Recommendations API
info.description: Research backend API for energy consumption analysis, statistical and AI-based anomaly detection, and evidence-driven energy efficiency recommendations.

get.description: Root endpoint pointing to interactive documentation and health.
Check service health and database connectivity.

post.description: Upload a CSV, XLSX, XLS, or PDF energy consumption document. The file is securely streamed, validated by signature, preprocessed, and persisted to the internal database. The original file is removed after parsing.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all active datasets with metadata.

schema.description: Maximum number of items to return
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return

get.description: Retrieve detailed metadata and data quality metrics for a specific dataset ID.

delete.description: Permanently remove a dataset, its energy records, cached analysis results, and any associated generated report files.

get.description: Compute descriptive consumption statistics, cost summaries, baseline comparisons, and identify records with unusually high energy consumption via robust z-scores.

post.description: Train an IsolationForest model on dataset features to flag unusual consumption patterns. Includes cyclical time features, guards against division-by-zero, and automatically falls back to a robust IQR rule-based detector if records are below the minimum threshold. Identical parameter configurations are cached deterministically.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent stored anomaly detection results for a dataset with pagination and filtering.

get.description: Generate grounded, evidence-driven recommendations based on actual dataset observations. Evaluates off-hours base draw, persistent elevations above baseline, high-consuming entities, and data logging gaps. Financial savings are computed only when supported by dataset cost records or an explicit user-provided tariff.
